scope: Static disassembly and Mach-O data reads only; no application calls, product execution or tests

preambleFields.name: currentStateId
preambleFields.proof: get_current_state loads object+0x90; set_current_state writes it subject to current <= maximum

preambleFields.name: maxStateId
preambleFields.proof: note_state at 0x167a10..0x167a24 increments +0x94 then writes both +0x90 and +0x94; set_delta_state and set_current_state bound current by maximum

preambleFields.name: maxStatesToKeep
preambleFields.proof: named set_max_states_to_keep stores its int argument at +0x78; zero avoids the pruning loop

preambleFields.name: nextEntityTag
preambleFields.proof: tag at 0x1618e4..0x161904 chooses this counter for an unspecified entity tag and stores chosenTag+1; assign_tag uses the same counter
preambleFields.qualification: native save option may emit -1 instead; existing production profiles require nonnegative entity-tag state

integerDomain: All four preamble scalars are native signed int values emitted by write_int(int); BinaryFile8 uses a signed 64-bit tagged wire slot

priorHypotheses.claim: first two values are duplicated stream generation or stream size
priorHypotheses.reason: native accessor and state-allocation instructions prove distinct current and maximum state IDs; rolled_back stores 3 and 10

priorHypotheses.claim: fourth value is history entry count, board allocation or stream identifier
priorHypotheses.reason: named tag and assign_tag mutate the exact saved object+0 counter for ENTITY tag allocation

priorHypotheses.claim: board value is an ordinal identity
priorHypotheses.reason: restore reads an enum and debug maps values to mainline/stacked/succeeded/failed

oldApiMapping.newMaxStateId: defaults to CurrentStateId when omitted, is independently preserved when present

externalResearch.use: Independent comparison of history framing and archived revision semantics; disputed preamble labels are superseded by the native evidence above
